itemGroup.create_ballistics: Create Big Cannons: Fire Control Ballistics
key.categories.create_ballistics: Create Big Cannons: Fire Control Ballistics
item.create_ballistics.drone.help:
Right-click a block to deploy the drone
Shift right-click with an empty hand to pack it back up
The drone has durability - hitting walls or the ground costs some
item.create_ballistics.monitor.help:
Right-click a recon drone to bind · shift right-click to unbind
Once bound, right-click to enter the drone view and fly it
Right-click again to leave the view - the drone keeps hovering
Works with the artillery indicator: mark targets and fire from the drone

item.create_ballistics.monitor.taken: That drone is already bound to someone else

gui.create_ballistics.drone.hud.near_sim: Near the simulation distance limit - flying further will destroy the drone
item.create_ballistics.artillery_indicat:
Press [%s] to open the GUI and change modes
Shift right-click a fire control computer to bind · right-click it again to unbind
Hold right-click to zoom, scroll to change the zoom level, middle-click to mark a target
Hold left-click to issue a fire command
Held in the offhand, it can mark positions and fire from the drone - same controls as above
Not bound to a fire control computer

gui.create_ballistics.model.gb: GB Realistic Ballistics (quadratic drag + real gravity)
block.create_ballistics.fire_control_nod: Fire Control Node
block.create_ballistics.fire_control_com:
Works out the firing solution from the gun's data and the target
Gives elevation, charge and flight time
Right-click to open the panel and set target, arc and fire mode
Needs rotation on its back, 64 SU per 1 RPM - no speed, no solution
Carries up to 4 fire control coordinators
block.create_ballistics.fire_control_coo:
The hub of the gun network - it registers the guns below it
Passes the computer's target down and orders the volley
Carries up to 10 guns, nearest first
Must be within 64 blocks of a fire control computer
Needs rotation on its back, 32 SU per 1 RPM
block.create_ballistics.fire_control_nod:
Place it against any face of a cannon mount (including top and bottom)
Drives that one gun's elevation, traverse and firing
The face that looked at you when placed takes the shaft
Rotation sets how fast the turret turns - no rotation, no work
Must be within 32 blocks of a fire control coordinator
